bobsweep - dustin robot vacuum & mop, au.description: Dustin Plus is the more reliable, stronger, smarter, and more efficient robotic vacuum cleaner and mop that every home needs. Engineered in the United States with cutting-edge software and navigation code, Dustin Plus is at the forefront of clean tech innovation. Designed to tackle everyday cleaning challenges, it combines top-tier technology with practical functionality, all with the aim of providing a thorough, hassle-free cleaning experience. Two of the standout features of Dustin Plus are its impressive 1-gallon dust collection station and powerful 8,000 pascal suction. The 1-gallon dust collection station offers over twice the capacity of most self-emptying robotic vacuums on the market. This large disposable dust bag is reinforced with activated charcoal, sealing and blocking odors. With 8,000 pascal suction power, Dustin effortlessly lifts dust, dirt, and debris from various surfaces, including carpets, area rugs, hardwood, and tile, ensuring a deep clean. Whether it’s a small living room, a large multi-room home, or a multi-floor house, Dustin Plus has the features, capacity, and power to handle it all. What truly sets bObsweep bots apart is their navigation prowess. Equipped with LiDAR technology and advanced Quantum Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (QSLAM) software, Dustin Plus is an expert at navigating any space. Within minutes, it maps the environment and identifies rooms with precision, skipping the need for lengthy exploration sessions. Users can view a detailed, color-coded map of their home via the mobile app, where they can create customized cleaning schedules, set NoSweep or NoMop zones, and divide or connect rooms to make their ideal map. If the job isn’t finished in one cycle, Dustin Plus seamlessly resumes cleaning from where it left off after recharging. Privacy is a priority at bObsweep. Unlike many smart devices, bObsweep bots respect your privacy by never capturing or sending images of your home or cleaning habits to any cloud server. This assurance of privacy, combined with Dustin’s powerful cleaning and smart features, makes it not only a trusted household companion but also a testament to the value of clean tech. With Dustin Plus, the cleaning of your home is done smarter, more efficiently, and securely, bringing you peace of mind and sparkling floors.
